#include <iostream>
#include <stack>
#include <string>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    
    std::stack<char> currentRun;
    int insert = 0;
    
    for (char c : s) {
        if (!currentRun.empty() && currentRun.top() != c) {
            if (currentRun.size() % 2 == 0) {
                insert++;
            }
            while (!currentRun.empty()) {
                currentRun.pop();
            }
        }
        currentRun.push(c);
    }
    
    if (!currentRun.empty() && currentRun.size() % 2 == 0) {
        insert++;
    }
    
    std::cout << insert << std::endl;
    
    return 0;
}
